theme_archetype: Archetype 1: Organic & Earthy mixed with Archetype 5: Luxury (Light Variant) - 'Sacred Ivory & Temple Gold'
design_philosophy: Transition from dark cosmic to a devotional, airy, and premium light theme. Preserving the sacred Vedic essence using 'parchment' and 'ink' metaphors rather than generic SaaS flat colors. High contrast for multi-script readability.

indic_scripts.weight: 500 for headings, 400 for body (ensure text color is #1A1C29 for contrast)

text_gold_gradient.note: Darkened slightly from the dark-mode version to ensure WCAG contrast against Ivory background.

cosmic_bg_light.glows: radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 10%, rgba(255,140,0,0.05), transparent 55%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 90%, rgba(212,175,55,0.05), transparent 55%)

media_urls.description: A close-up of a hand holding flower offerings during a Hindu ritual.
Bunch of yellow and pink flowers for auspicious decorative elements.
Detailed view of historical calligraphy on ancient parchment to be used as a subtle background blend for the AI reading section.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Open /app/frontend/src/index.css and replace the :root variables under @layer base with the new light theme variables provided in css_variables_update.

2. Update the .cosmic-bg class in index.css to use #FDFBF7 instead of #0A0D14. Reduce the opacity of the SVG overlays (mandala stroke-opacity to 0.04, paisley stroke-opacity to 0.03) and gradients (to 0.05).
3. Overhaul .glass-card, .premium-card, and .btn-saffron in index.css using the exact properties defined in component_patterns to ensure they work on a light background.
4. Modify .text-gold-gradient to use darker gold/copper shades (#B87333 to #D96600) so it remains legible against the white/ivory background.
5. Ensure the Kundali chart SVG lines default to stroke 'currentColor' or var(--foreground) (#1A1C29) so they render as deep indigo ink instead of glowing white.
6. Check any components using hardcoded dark hex codes (e.g. bg-[#0A0D14]) and replace them with semantic classes (bg-background, bg-card).
7. Ensure text contrast across the 4 languages (EN, HI, TE, TA). Indic fonts should use weight 400 for body text and 500 for headings, pulling text color from --foreground.
8. Add `data-testid` attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, language picker, tier cards, booking slots) for testing.
